newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Two-thirds of Moroccan women illiterate.
newsitem.headline: Two-thirds of Moroccan women illiterate.

text.p: Two out of every three Moroccan women are illiterate, nearly twice the illiteracy rate among the country's male population, a research centre said on Friday.
Sixty-five percent of Moroccan women and 36.7 percent of men cannot read or write, according to a study by the Rabat-based Centre d'Etudes et de Recherches Demographiques (CERED).
In rural areas, 87.5 percent of women and 54.6 percent of men are illiterate. In urban areas only 8.2 percent of girls and 11.7 percent of boys enter secondary school, CERED said.
A 1994 census showed that 54.9 percent Morocco's 27 million people were illiterate.
